multiplan.title: Software Engineer
multiplan.item1: Developed and launched an end-to-end MVP for an automated License Plate Recognition (LPR) system using Node.js and React, successfully scaling to 30k+ active users within the first month and growing to 100k+ daily active users with over 2M licensed plates stored.
multiplan.item2: Drove a 200% increase in registered users (100k to 300k+) in 6 months by engineering the client-side orchestration of a multi-provider payment system, ensuring a frictionless checkout experience with providers like Sem Parar, ConectCar and Veloe.
multiplan.item3: Optimized application performance by refactoring the caching strategy with React Apollo Client, resulting in a 70% reduction in API requests and a faster UX.
multiplan.item4: Reduced user processing time by 90% (10m to <60s) by engineering an automated parking exemption system for 6+ major malls, eliminating physical tickets for partners like gyms and supermarkets.
multiplan.item5: Decreased critical errors by 20% and cut operational costs by increasing test coverage by 30% and implementing advanced analytics and observability with MixPanel and BugSnag.
multiplan.item6: Boosted user retention by 23% by migrating EV Charger communications from WebSockets to Polling, resolving critical sync issues under a tight deadline.
multiplan.item7: Architected daily cron job for vehicle tier migration using Node.js, orchestrating monolith and microservice communication via GraphQL with a batch processing strategy and Promise.allSettled for fault-tolerant execution, and developed internal backoffice tools for A/B testing and Feature Flags.
